release.name: v1.2.1
release.notes: # Nola Translator 1.2.1 A maintenance update with fixes for local model selection, data migration, model downloads, and the Windows tray icon. ## Highlights - Fixed installed local language models not appearing in the workbench model selector. - Updated model selection to include configured local and cloud models. - Fixed data paths for custom installation directories and migrated legacy user data to the installation’s `Data` folder. - Added a migration progress dialog before the main window opens. - Cleaned model download caches and resume fragments at startup. - Fixed the application logo not appearing in the Windows system tray. - Fixed additional issues with the model gateway, captions, runtime, and browser extensions. ## Download - [Windows x64 Installer (EXE)](https://github.com/CerealAxis/Nola-Translator/releases/download/v1.2.1/Nola-Translator-1.2.1-Windows-x64-Setup.exe) - [Source ZIP](https://github.com/CerealAxis/Nola-Translator/releases/download/v1.2.1/Nola-Translator-1.2.1-Source.zip) - [Firefox Extension](https://github.com/CerealAxis/Nola-Translator/releases/download/v1.2.1/Nola-Firefox-Extension-v1.1.4.zip) ## Changelog - [Compare v1.2.0...v1.2.1](https://github.com/CerealAxis/Nola-Translator/compare/v1.2.0...v1.2.1) ## Contributors --- # Nola Translator 1.2.1 本次更新修复了本地模型选择、旧版本数据迁移、模型下载和 Windows 系统托盘图标等问题。 ## 重点更新 - 修复已安装的本地语言模型未出现在工作台模型选择中的问题。 - 调整模型选择列表，显示已配置的本地模型和云端模型。 - 修复自定义安装目录下的数据路径处理，并将旧版本用户数据迁移到安装目录的 `Data` 文件夹。 - 新增迁移进度弹窗，迁移完成后再打开主窗口。 - 调整模型下载缓存和断点续传碎片的清理时机，在启动时清理。 - 修复 Windows 系统托盘未显示软件图标的问题。 - 修复模型网关、字幕、运行环境和浏览器扩展中的其他问题。 ## 下载 >[!TIP] >以下超链接自动指向 `gh-proxy.com` 镜像源下载 -
